title: ImageKit Integration & Activity Log UX

highlight.title: Branded Loading UX & Cloud Media
highlight.description: Integrated ImageKit CDN with an animated branded loading ring for profile pictures.

summary: This update resolves avatar upload issues through ImageKit integration, enhances the Activity Log with relative dates and improved privacy, and hardens the deployment infrastructure.

categories.title: Improvements
items: Integrated ImageKit CDN for high-performance profile picture hosting.
Implemented an animated SVG loading ring in branded purple (#8652E2) for avatar uploads.
Standardized Activity Log with relative "Time-Ago" dates across the dashboard and log pages.
Refined Activity Log layout to show profile slugs (e.g. "lovi") and move visitor locations for better clarity.

categories.title: Fixes
items: Resolved 500 and "Missing File" errors during profile picture uploads in v7+ SDK.
Fixed WebAuthn RP_ID and Origin mismatches for stable localhost testing environment.
Enabled `trust proxy` in the backend for accurate visitor geolocation in production.
Updated GitHub Actions deployment workflow with ImageKit production secrets.

title: Identity & Infrastructure Scalability

highlight.title: Futuristic Liveness UI
highlight.description: Integrated an advanced AI-driven biometric verification flow with resilient retry logic.

summary: This release introduces a new high-fidelity mobile liveness experience, significantly optimizes landing page load times, and adds core infrastructure for careers and enterprise identity integrations.

categories.title: Improvements
items: Integrated futuristic Mobile Liveness UI with real-time AI status feedback.
Optimized landing page assets: Replaced heavy 7MB PNGs with WebP, saving 14MB in total load weight.
Enhanced PWA resilience: Increased Workbox pre-cache limit to 10MB to accommodate modern application bundles.
Launched Careers & Affiliate application engine with automated email notifications.
Implemented RSA-2048 signing foundation for upcoming enterprise identity features.

categories.title: Fixes
items: Fixed Vercel build failures caused by large asset pre-caching limits.
Updated passkey authentication flows for better mobile-to-desktop handoff stability.
Resolved QR code URL structure issues for improved mobile scanning reliability.
